st-an-dist-nicobar.name: Nicobar
st-an-dist-nicobar.description: District of Andaman and Nicobar Islands (Union Territory), India, headquartered at Car Nicobar. Population approximately 36,842 (2011 census), area approximately 1,841 km2.

st-an-dist-north-and-middle-andaman.name: North and Middle Andaman
st-an-dist-north-and-middle-andaman.description: District of Andaman and Nicobar Islands (Union Territory), India, headquartered at Mayabunder. Population approximately 105,597 (2011 census), area approximately 3,736 km2.

st-an-dist-south-andaman.name: South Andaman
st-an-dist-south-andaman.description: District of Andaman and Nicobar Islands (Union Territory), India, headquartered at Port Blair. Population approximately 238,142 (2011 census), area approximately 2,672 km2.

st-an-gram-panchayats.name: Gram Panchayats of Andaman and Nicobar Islands
st-an-gram-panchayats.description: The village-level tier of Panchayati Raj Institutions in Andaman and Nicobar Islands, directly elected under Part IX of the Constitution.
st-an-gram-panchayats.legalBasis: Constitution of India, Part IX (73rd Amendment, 1992)
st-an-gram-panchayats.notes: State-wise seat/panchayat count could not be sourced in this research pass: lgdirectory.gov.in's per-state query reports (globalViewStatewiseLocalBody.do and the Download Directory PRI reports) require solving a CAPTCHA to retrieve data, which is outside permitted tooling; only the LGD homepage's national totals (see Local Government of India (aggregate)) were accessible without one. No alternate state-wise secondary source was found before the session's web-search budget was exhausted.

st-an-panchayat-samitis.name: Panchayat Samitis of Andaman and Nicobar Islands
st-an-panchayat-samitis.description: The intermediate (block) tier of Panchayati Raj Institutions in Andaman and Nicobar Islands, directly elected under Part IX of the Constitution.
st-an-panchayat-samitis.legalBasis: Constitution of India, Part IX (73rd Amendment, 1992)
st-an-panchayat-samitis.notes: State-wise count not sourced; see st-<code>-gram-panchayats notes for why (LGD per-state reports are CAPTCHA-gated).

st-an-zila-parishads.name: Zila Parishads of Andaman and Nicobar Islands
st-an-zila-parishads.description: The district-level tier of Panchayati Raj Institutions in Andaman and Nicobar Islands, directly elected under Part IX of the Constitution.
st-an-zila-parishads.legalBasis: Constitution of India, Part IX (73rd Amendment, 1992)
st-an-zila-parishads.notes: State-wise count not sourced; see st-<code>-gram-panchayats notes for why (LGD per-state reports are CAPTCHA-gated). Typically one Zila Parishad per district, so the count should be close to (but need not exactly equal) the district count.

st-an-urban-local-bodies.name: Urban Local Bodies of Andaman and Nicobar Islands
st-an-urban-local-bodies.description: The urban local self-government bodies of Andaman and Nicobar Islands (municipal corporations, municipalities/municipal councils and nagar/town panchayats), constituted under Part IXA of the Constitution.
st-an-urban-local-bodies.legalBasis: Constitution of India, Part IXA (74th Amendment, 1992)
st-an-urban-local-bodies.notes: Only the municipal-corporation count is directly sourced (Wikipedia 'List of municipal corporations in India', cross-validated against the national total of 273 on lgdirectory.gov.in's dashboard). Municipality/nagar-panchayat (municipal council / nagar panchayat) counts per state were not obtainable without the CAPTCHA-gated LGD per-state reports or an additional secondary source, and are left out rather than estimated.

st-an-dept-home.name: Home Department
st-an-dept-home.description: Handles police, prisons, internal security and general law-and-order administration for the islands.

st-an-dept-finance-excise.name: Finance and Excise Department
st-an-dept-finance-excise.description: Manages the UT's budget, treasury, expenditure control and excise/liquor regulation.

st-an-dept-planning.name: Planning Department
st-an-dept-planning.description: Coordinates development planning and central-sector scheme allocations for the UT.

st-an-dept-economics-statistics.name: Directorate of Economics and Statistics
st-an-dept-economics-statistics.description: Compiles official statistics, price indices and socio-economic surveys for the islands.

st-an-dept-revenue.name: Revenue Department
st-an-dept-revenue.description: Manages land records, land revenue, disaster relief funds and revenue courts.

st-an-dept-personnel-ar.name: Personnel and Administrative Reforms Department
st-an-dept-personnel-ar.description: Handles civil service recruitment, service matters and administrative reforms for UT employees.

st-an-dept-information-technology.name: Information Technology Department
st-an-dept-information-technology.description: Runs e-governance, digital services and IT infrastructure for the administration (SOVTECH).

st-an-dept-urban-development.name: Urban Development Department
st-an-dept-urban-development.description: Oversees municipal councils, town planning and urban infrastructure across the islands.

st-an-dept-health.name: Directorate of Health Services
st-an-dept-health.description: Runs government hospitals, primary health centres and public health programmes, including NHM.

st-an-dept-labour-employment.name: Department of Labour, Employment and Training
st-an-dept-labour-employment.description: Regulates labour welfare, industrial relations and runs employment exchanges and ITIs.

st-an-dept-civil-supplies.name: Directorate of Civil Supplies and Consumer Affairs
st-an-dept-civil-supplies.description: Runs the public distribution system (ration shops) and consumer protection.

st-an-dept-education.name: Directorate of Education
st-an-dept-education.description: Runs government schools, higher and technical education and sports programmes.

st-an-dept-power.name: Electricity Department
st-an-dept-power.description: Generates and distributes electric power across the island chain.

st-an-dept-environment-forest.name: Department of Environment and Forest
st-an-dept-environment-forest.description: Manages forest cover, wildlife sanctuaries and environmental clearances on the islands.

st-an-dept-pwd.name: Andaman Public Works Department
st-an-dept-pwd.description: Builds and maintains government buildings, roads and rural infrastructure.

st-an-dept-agriculture.name: Department of Agriculture
st-an-dept-agriculture.description: Supports crop farming, horticulture and agricultural extension services.

st-an-dept-animal-husbandry.name: Department of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Services
st-an-dept-animal-husbandry.description: Runs veterinary hospitals, livestock development and dairy schemes.

st-an-dept-fisheries.name: Department of Fisheries
st-an-dept-fisheries.description: Supports marine and inland fisheries, fishing harbours and fisherfolk welfare.

st-an-dept-disaster-management.name: Directorate of Disaster Management
st-an-dept-disaster-management.description: Coordinates cyclone, tsunami and earthquake preparedness and relief for the islands.

st-an-dept-rd-pri.name: Directorate of Rural Development, Panchayati Raj Institutions and ULBs
st-an-dept-rd-pri.description: Runs rural development schemes and oversees Panchayati Raj institutions and local bodies.

st-an-dept-science-technology.name: Department of Science, Technology and Pollution Control
st-an-dept-science-technology.description: Oversees pollution control, scientific research promotion and technology initiatives.

st-an-dept-cooperation.name: Registrar of Cooperative Societies
st-an-dept-cooperation.description: Regulates and promotes cooperative societies across the islands.

st-an-dept-official-language.name: Official Language (Rajbhasha) Department
st-an-dept-official-language.description: Promotes the use of Hindi in official government work under the Official Languages Act.

st-an-dept-industries.name: Directorate of Industries
st-an-dept-industries.description: Promotes small and medium industry, MSME registration and industrial estates.

st-an-dept-ipt-tourism.name: Department of Information, Publicity and Tourism
st-an-dept-ipt-tourism.description: Runs the government's public information wing and promotes tourism to the islands.

st-an-dept-transport.name: Directorate of Transport
st-an-dept-transport.description: Regulates road transport, vehicle registration and public bus services, including civil aviation coordination.

st-an-dept-shipping.name: Directorate of Shipping Services
st-an-dept-shipping.description: Operates inter-island passenger ships and manages the Port Management Board.

st-an-dept-social-welfare.name: Directorate of Social Welfare
st-an-dept-social-welfare.description: Runs welfare schemes for children, women, the elderly and persons with disabilities, and the UT Commission for Protection of Child Rights.

st-an-dept-tribal-welfare.name: Directorate of Tribal Welfare
st-an-dept-tribal-welfare.description: Runs welfare schemes for the islands' Scheduled Tribes, including the Andaman Adim Janjati Vikas Samiti.

st-an-dept-art-culture.name: Directorate of Art and Culture
st-an-dept-art-culture.description: Promotes local art, culture, archives and heritage preservation.

st-an-dept-vigilance.name: Vigilance Department
st-an-dept-vigilance.description: Investigates corruption complaints against government servants (Anti-Corruption/Vigilance wing).

st-an-dept-law.name: Law Department
st-an-dept-law.description: Provides legal advice to the administration and handles litigation and drafting of local rules.

st-an-dept-ga-protocol.name: General Administration and Protocol Department
st-an-dept-ga-protocol.description: Handles VIP protocol, cabinet/secretariat coordination and general administrative matters.

st-an-dept-housing-estate.name: Housing and Estate Department
st-an-dept-housing-estate.description: Allots and manages government residential and office accommodation.

st-an-dept-archives.name: Directorate of Archives
st-an-dept-archives.description: Preserves and maintains the UT's historical government records.

st-an-dept-parliamentary-affairs.name: Parliamentary Affairs Department
st-an-dept-parliamentary-affairs.description: Coordinates the administration's response to Parliament questions concerning the UT.

st-an-dept-police.name: Andaman and Nicobar Police
st-an-dept-police.description: The UT police force responsible for law and order, crime investigation and traffic policing.

st-an-electorate.name: People of Andaman and Nicobar Islands
st-an-electorate.nameHi: अंडमान और निकोबार द्वीपसमूह की जनता
st-an-electorate.description: The residents and voters of Andaman and Nicobar Islands, a Union Territory administered by the Union government.
